diagnosis: a1-einmal repeats two Slovak synonyms for one meaning.
a1-essen-study repeats Jedlo and Pokrm instead of using one Slovak headword that covers the source contexts.
a1-huebsch adds a synonym to the headword although the source headword has one core target value.
a1-kein repeats near-synonymous negative determiners and contains an unnatural milk example.
a1-frau study.examples[0].lv changes explicit subject Sie to demonstrative Je to.
The proof alignment denominators are calculated against the old defective SK card rather than the authoritative LV-DE source.
